rationale_md: Colombia enters this Group K encounter as the clear favorite, backed by a substantial 260-point Elo rating advantage over Uzbekistan that reflects their status as a top South American side facing an emerging Asian opponent. The model assigns Colombia nearly 60% probability of victory, more than double Uzbekistan's chances, suggesting the Cafeteros' superior technical quality and international pedigree should prove decisive. While Uzbekistan has made strides in recent years, the gap between CONMEBOL's elite and Central Asian football remains significant enough to make an upset unlikely.
